comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
A new Christmas event has begun in Bergen. Looks to be this one:

gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?LiveEvent/Xmas2013
uwo.ogplanet.com/en/news/event/9402.og

Purple Santa clothes for both genders will be available as rewards... at some point. Since it literally just began a few minutes ago, I have no other information to offer at this time.

comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body:
Eh, there's a handy guide to the Christmas 2015 event that awards this outfit and its matching hat, right here!

nforum.ogplanet.com/uwo/forum_posts.asp?TID=645872

comments.author: Bael
comments.body: Is blue the only costume available at the moment?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: All Santa outfits in UWO are usually available as part of a Christmas event. This year's "event" (not quite the same as actual server events like the Wannabe Vikings one) only gave out blue. I believe the red Santa clothes were sold in the cash shop last year? I know of no others available in-game, at any rate.
